title: feat(studio): remove the Studio home; /studio opens the last package or Setup > Packages
body:
Fixes #36908
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员和开发者打开 `/studio` 不再看到软件包卡片页：有上次用过的软件包就直接进它，没有就进设置里的软件包列表；已安装应用「改了什么」挪到设置的软件包详情里。
- 这是 Studio 重构专题的「去掉 Studio 首页」一步，首页上的每个入口都换了新地方，已在真实环境逐个走过。
- 如果出错，用户进 Studio 会落到软件包列表或「全部元数据」页，而不是首页；这次只改界面，不改数据，可以直接撤回。
- 本 PR 超过 3000 行（主要是删除旧首页和它的测试），请您按大 PR 流程审核后再合并。

## What changes

Epic #36890 decision 9: the package-card page at bare `/studio` (`BuilderLanding`) is removed. This PR finds a new home for every entry it carried and deletes the page, the code only it used, and its tests.

| Entry the home carried | Where it goes now |
|:---|:---|
| bare `/studio` | `StudioEntryRedirect` (in the lazy Studio chunk). It opens the newest remembered package (the recent `package` entries `StudioRoute` records) that `GET /api/v1/packages` still lists. Otherwise it goes to Setup → Packages (`/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?face=admin`) if the user holds `setup.access` and `manage_platform_settings`. A user who may enter Studio but not that page goes to `/studio/~all/metadata`. If the list cannot be read, it opens the newest remembered package, and Studio reports the failed read itself. |
| New package (`/studio?new=package`) | `SETUP_NEW_PACKAGE_PATH`: the admin face with `?new=package`. It opens New Package on arrival and drops the param with a replace. After create it lands in Studio on the new package (#36834). Callers: Home's 「New in Studio」, the `/ai` no-assistant screen, the 「Add app」 menu. An old `/studio?new=package` bookmark is forwarded there. One-step 新建应用 is #37134. |
| `~all` / `~org` cards | Already in the left menu (#36899). Nothing more to do here. |
| Per-app "n customized, m switched off" and the "Customizations in this environment" panel | `PackageCustomizationsPanel`, shown in a read-only base's detail sheet on the admin face. It is not shown for an authored package, a `.custom` pair or a kernel package. It has a summary line, rows with tabs (adds Layouts), search, Show all, and 「Customize in Studio」. **"Customized" now counts `counts.arrangements`.** This delivers #36833's requirement in the panel's new home; #36833 was closed as not planned (ruling 7125820739), so this PR does not close it. |
| Card Manage and the All packages link (development face) | Not this card: the door is added by #37139 (card note 7146329913). The development face stays reachable by its address. |
| Recently viewed | Now Studio's entry itself: `/studio` opens the newest remembered package. |
| 「包不存在」 → Studio home | The button opens Setup → Packages (new key `engine.studio.notFound.packageList`). |
| `AppContent` fallbacks, `packagedActionsStudioPath` fallback with no package named | `SETUP_PACKAGES_PATH`. |
| `studio:builder` (the `@objectstack/studio` app's 「应用构建」) | Forwards to `/studio`. |

Removed: `BuilderLanding.tsx`, its 14 `BuilderLanding.*` test files, `fetchInstalledPackageRow` (only the home's Manage called it) with its pin, and the home's console frame in `StudioRoute` (header and command palette). `LandingCustomizationsPanel` and `landingCustomizations-io` were renamed and rewritten as `PackageCustomizationsPanel` and `packageCustomizationRows`. `newAppDoor.ts` and the `engine.studio.newApp.*` strings stay for #37134.

**Strings.** The home's `engine.studio.landing.*` keys and `engine.studio.landingHome` that ship in the released `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` (68 keys, measured against the published tarball) stay in `en` and `zh`, no longer read. Removing a published key is a narrowing, so this PR removes none. The four landing keys added after 18.6.0 and never released (`manage`, `manageTitle`, `allPackages`, `allPackagesTitle`) are removed. The three duplicate-form keys the Packages page reads are unchanged. `engine.packages.customizations.*` and `engine.studio.notFound.packageList` are added.

Checklist: `studio-authoring.package-customization-counts-and-marks` (rev 4) and `studio-authoring.org-scope-flows` (rev 5) are re-pointed. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` judges 11 anchors with 0 lost at this head.

Size: about +1,610 / -5,318 across 82 files, mostly deletions. Per ruling 7145880574 on #36890 this lands as one PR, reviewed by the maintainer after L1. Overlaps at this head (overlap-check): origin/main merges cleanly. #37169 and #37168 conflict in `BuilderLanding.*` test files this branch deletes, the not-found pin, and the studio `en`/`zh` namespaces; whichever lands second merges main. #37089 and #37148 merge cleanly.

### Read first

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioEntryRedirect.tsx`: the whole `/studio` decision. Risk: where a non-administrator lands (the `studioEntryFallbackPath` capability pair).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageCustomizationsPanel.tsx` and the mount in `PackagesPage.tsx` (`PackageDetailSheet`). Risk: the gate `!authoring && !writable && !isKernel && !isCustomizationPackage(id)`.
3. `ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`: the index route and the `StudioEntryPermissions` context passed down from the entry gate.

### Two-minute verification

As the seeded admin with nothing remembered, open `/_console/studio`. Expected: you land on Setup → Packages (`…/developer/packages?face=admin`). Open the ObjectStack Showcase row: its detail shows "Customizations in this environment" with a Customize in Studio link.

## Tests

New pins:
- `StudioEntryRedirect.test.tsx` (9 cases): the newest remembered package the list still names opens; a package the list no longer names is skipped; nothing remembered leads to Setup → Packages, read without a list request; a Studio-only principal lands on `~all`; a failed list read opens the newest remembered package; the old new-package bookmark is forwarded.
- `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`: the rows and counts, including the **#36833 arrangement-only case**; the empty and failed states (never "0"); row and switched-off-action links; tabs, search and Show all; zh words; and the moved rows and labels io.
- In the `PackagesPage` administration-face harness, two describes: "the new-package deep link" (3 cases) and "a read-only base's customizations in its detail" (3 cases: a code package draws the section with arrangements counted; an authored package does not; the development face does not).
- Converted, not deleted: the StudioRoute gate, lazy-module, recent-visit and access-notice pins; `studio:builder` registration (now a forward); not-found (now Setup → Packages); `setupMetadataRedirect`; `studioAddress`; the Home, sidebar 「Add app」 and `/ai` deep-link hrefs; the vocabulary census; `consoleTopBar.height-12639` (the deleted frame leaves its census; five frames remain); `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578` (a packaged-actions bookmark naming no package now opens Setup → Packages; the named-package case is unchanged).

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- Targeted vitest at `9bf2706e`, one locked run: every changed `ui/` test file, plus `apps/console/src`, `packages/i18n/src`, `views/studio-design`, `metadata-admin/PackagesPage*`, `console/__tests__/AppContent*` and `console/home/__tests__/HomePage*`. Result: Test Files 1 failed, 825 passed (826); Tests 2 failed, 8714 passed, 13 skipped. The two failures were `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`, the same pin CI's Test UI (8/16) named. Fixed at `a21c7b6f`; that file plus `consoleTopBar.height-12639` then read Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 95 passed (95), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation of the converted pin, at `a21c7b6f`: `packagedActionsStudioPath`'s no-package return mutated back to `'/studio'` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `185cb367` → `c561a012`). The pin read 2 failed / 84, exactly the two converted cases. Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- type-check at `a21c7b6f`, after building `@object-ui/console^...`: `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`) and `@object-ui/console` all passed, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Gates at `a21c7b6f`, exit codes captured before any pipe, all 0: check:nul-bytes, check:test-source-alias, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:i18n-stale-fill, check:keyed-text-bounds, check:i18n (all bundles in sync), check:issue-citations, check-changeset-no-major, check-empty-changeset, check-closing-keyword-parity, check:platform-checklist, check:gitlink-declared, and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (11 anchors, 0 lost). `dispatch-gates --ran` names the other 62 derived families as not run locally. That narrowing is declared: they derive from the whole branch diff, not this round's four files, and their evidence is the PR's check-runs.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Two console test files pinned only the home's frame and are deleted: `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx` (its header crumb) and `StudioRoute.searchPalette-11863.test.tsx` (⌘K on the home; ⌘K inside Studio is #36900). The other StudioRoute pins now stub the entry.
- Duplicate pins named for deleted tests (AGENTS.md, ruling 6120820653): the new-package deep link is pinned in the `PackagesPage` admin harness ("the new-package deep link"); the customization counts, rows and labels in `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`; the org-scope entry by `StudioDesignSurface.packageLessFlows-11553` and the menu pins from #36899. The home's own layout, ordering, Duplicate form, recent cards, Manage and new-app door pins have no remaining surface to pin.
- Possibly orphaned now that the frame is gone, not removed here: `AppHeader` `variant="studio"` and `CommandPalette` `scope="studio"` (#36900 may reuse the scope).
- With an AI build surface served, the 「Build with AI」 entry (Home and 「Add app」) still targets bare `/studio`. It now opens the last package, or Setup → Packages for an admin with nothing remembered. The removed home had no AI surface of its own, so no AI entry was lost; whether it should open somewhere else is left to the seat.
- The 68 published landing keys are kept and unread. `check-i18n-dead-keys` (report-only, not in CI) will list them as candidates, and a later change can decide to retire them.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` still names `BuilderLanding` in a dated follow-up entry; it is a log and was left as written.

## Verification

Walked on a live stack at `a21c7b6f`. Server: `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --seed-admin -p 4710` (CLI and showcase closure built in a worktree). Console: this branch's `ui/apps/console` under Vite on 4711, proxied to it. Signed in as the seeded admin and driven with Playwright; key screens confirmed by screenshot.

| Entry | Observed |
|:---|:---|
| `/studio`, nothing remembered | → `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/developer/packages?face=admin` |
| `/studio?new=package` (old bookmark) | → same page, `new=package` dropped, New Package dialog open |
| `/apps/setup/component/automation/packaged-actions` (no package) | → Setup → Packages (admin face) |
| `/studio/no_such_pkg_36908` | 「Package not found…」 with 「Open the package list」 → Setup → Packages |
| ObjectStack Showcase (code) row → detail | "Customizations in this environment", "No changes in this environment yet", Customize in Studio → `/studio/com.example.showcase/data` |
| `/studio` after visiting that package | → back into `/studio/com.example.showcase/data…` (remembered) |
| Sidebar app menu → 「Add app」 | New in Studio → `…packages?face=admin&new=package`; clicked, it lands there with the dialog open |
| `/ai` (no assistant on this stack) | 「New in Studio」 → `…packages?face=admin&new=package` |
| New Package dialog → Create package | → `/studio/com.default.walk-pkg-36908/data` |
| That authored package's detail | no customizations section (count 0); Open in Studio present |
| `/studio/~all/metadata` | renders the All Metadata Types area |

Not walked live: Home's 「New in Studio」 chip, which this seeded stack does not show because its condition does not hold here (its href is pinned in `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614` and `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`). Also not walked: a non-administrator's `/studio` landing (no such principal is seeded; `StudioEntryRedirect.test.tsx` pins it, and its target `~all` renders above), and `studio:builder` (the `@objectstack/studio` app does not load on a stock boot; `registerStudioComponents.builderLazy-11798` pins the forward).
